rv.q: Malvolio’s costume changes, for example, show the dramatic contrast before and after he is deceived into believing that Olivia loves him. The expressive facial makeup also serves the work both practically and aesthetically.
This is a heartening evening out, where the atmosphere is almost pantomime-like and the complicity between players and audience becomes total.
Sadly, most of it falls very flat.
With all this, Creation Theatre’s Twelfth Night is not one to miss.
Overall, it was a thoroughly enjoyable evening.

cn.t: Critics largely praise this outdoor production's playful, interactive atmosphere and comedic energy, though one reviewer finds it disappointing after a strong start.
